audit_events_previous_hash.name: audit_events_previous_hash
audit_events_previous_hash.value: "audit_events"."previous_hash_sha256" IS NULL OR (length("audit_events"."previous_hash_sha256") = 64 AND "audit_events"."previous_hash_sha256" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')

equity_valuations_status.name: equity_valuations_status
equity_valuations_status.value: ("equity_valuations"."status" = 'VERIFIED' AND "equity_valuations"."equity_minor" IS NOT NULL AND "equity_valuations"."unresolved_reason" IS NULL) OR ("equity_valuations"."status" = 'UNRESOLVED' AND "equity_valuations"."equity_minor" IS NULL AND "equity_valuations"."unresolved_reason" IS NOT NULL)

market_event_revisions_verified_source.name: market_event_revisions_verified_source
market_event_revisions_verified_source.value: "market_event_revisions"."verification_level" <> 'VERIFIED' OR ("market_event_revisions"."primary_source_record_id" IS NOT NULL AND "market_event_revisions"."verification_rule_version" IS NOT NULL AND "market_event_revisions"."data_class" <> 'FIXTURE' AND "market_event_revisions"."data_class" <> 'NOT_VERIFIED')

risk_decisions_money.name: risk_decisions_money
risk_decisions_money.value: ("risk_decisions"."risk_budget_minor" IS NULL OR "risk_decisions"."risk_budget_minor" >= 0) AND ("risk_decisions"."planned_loss_jpy_minor" IS NULL OR "risk_decisions"."planned_loss_jpy_minor" >= 0)

source_records_version_link.name: source_records_version_link
source_records_version_link.value: ("source_records"."record_version" = 1 AND "source_records"."supersedes_record_id" IS NULL) OR ("source_records"."record_version" > 1 AND "source_records"."supersedes_record_id" IS NOT NULL)

task_run_attempts_finished.name: task_run_attempts_finished
task_run_attempts_finished.value: ("task_run_attempts"."execution_status" = 'RUNNING' AND "task_run_attempts"."finished_at_ms" IS NULL) OR ("task_run_attempts"."execution_status" <> 'RUNNING' AND "task_run_attempts"."finished_at_ms" IS NOT NULL)

task_runs_lease.name: task_runs_lease
task_runs_lease.value: ("task_runs"."execution_status" = 'RUNNING' AND "task_runs"."lease_owner" IS NOT NULL AND "task_runs"."lease_until_ms" IS NOT NULL) OR ("task_runs"."execution_status" <> 'RUNNING' AND "task_runs"."lease_owner" IS NULL AND "task_runs"."lease_until_ms" IS NULL)

task_runs_finished.name: task_runs_finished
task_runs_finished.value: ("task_runs"."execution_status" IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') AND "task_runs"."finished_at_ms" IS NULL) OR ("task_runs"."execution_status" IN ('DONE', 'FAILED', 'BLOCKED_EXTERNAL', 'SKIPPED') AND "task_runs"."finished_at_ms" IS NOT NULL)

worker_state_lock.name: worker_state_lock
worker_state_lock.value: ("worker_state"."owner_id" IS NULL AND "worker_state"."process_id" IS NULL AND "worker_state"."acquired_at_ms" IS NULL AND "worker_state"."heartbeat_at_ms" IS NULL AND "worker_state"."lease_until_ms" IS NULL) OR ("worker_state"."owner_id" IS NOT NULL AND "worker_state"."process_id" > 0 AND "worker_state"."acquired_at_ms" IS NOT NULL AND "worker_state"."heartbeat_at_ms" IS NOT NULL AND "worker_state"."lease_until_ms" IS NOT NULL)
